message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is normally **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).

- **Standard time**:  
  - Los Angeles – Pacific Standard Time (PST) = UTC‑8  
  - Berlin – Central European Time (CET) = UTC+1  
  → 9 hour difference (Berlin is ahead).

- **Daylight‑saving time**:  
  - Los Angeles – Pacific Daylight Time (PDT) = UTC‑7  
  - Berlin – Central European Summer Time (CEST) = UTC+2  
  → still 9 hours difference (Berlin is ahead).

Because both regions shift forward by one hour at roughly the same time, the gap stays 9 hours most of the year. Only during the brief periods when one side has switched to DST and the other hasn’t (or vice versa) can the difference temporarily become 8 or 10 hours.
